typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT RIGHT((\'0000000000\'+CAST((SELECT COUNT(*)   FROM [BOSS].[PSGL].[FileHeaderMMR]   WHERE GLBUSUNIT IS NOT NULL AND GLBUSUNIT IN  (SELECT DISTINCT GLBUSUNIT FROM PSGL.FileDetailMMR)) +(SELECT COUNT(*)   FROM [BOSS].[PSGL].[FileDetailMMR]   WHERE GLBUSUNIT IS NOT NULL ) AS VARCHAR)),10)+   RIGHT((\'00000000000000000000000000000000000\'+CAST((SELECT SUM(DEBITAMOUNT) FROM PSGL.MMRSUBLEDGER) AS VARCHAR)),25)+   CAST((SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CREDITAMOUNT)<>0 THEN \'-\' ELSE \'0\' END  FROM PSGL.MMRSUBLEDGER) AS VARCHAR)   +   RIGHT((\'00000000000000000000000000000000000\'+CAST((SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CREDITAMOUNT)<>0 THEN    (-1)*SUM(CREDITAMOUNT) ELSE SUM(CREDITAMOUNT) END FROM PSGL.MMRSUBLEDGER) AS VARCHAR)),24)+ LEFT(CAST((SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) + REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), \':\', \'\')) AS VARCHAR),14)+ CAST(\'     \' AS VARCHAR) AS BALFILE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBCREATEBALFILE
SRCOLEDBCREATEBALFILE sink(input(
		BALFILE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		BALFILE)) ~> DSTFFCREATEBALFILE
